title: Bump undici to 8.12.3 in the dsh devcontainer
summary: A lockfile-only dependency bump: the `undici` HTTP client pinned inside the `.devcontainer/dsh` npm workspace moves from 8.11.2 to 8.12.3, with its resolved tarball URL and integrity hash updated to match. No source, manifest or runtime wiring changes — the only thing that moves is which undici build the devcontainer installs, so the blast radius is limited to whatever in that container performs HTTP through undici.
